description: Member Information prints each caption under its box's rule (box, caption, box, caption), so a caption sits right over the next row's box. Each box is named by its own caption, not its neighbour's: First Name and Last Name, not Member ID and Date of Birth. The section heading "Member Information" is a heading, not the label of the first box under it. The month, day and year boxes of the date of birth carry a wrong tooltip ("Member ID", the first box's); the printed caption "Date of Birth" names them, with their place in the row (#281).
